# `count`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns the total number of retrieved rows, including rows containing null.

count(expr[, expr...]) - Returns the number of rows for which the supplied expression(s) are all non-null.

count(DISTINCT expr[, expr...]) - Returns the number of rows for which the supplied expression(s) are unique and non-null.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
count(*)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `agg_funcs` |
| Kind | aggregate (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments |  >= 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- count, example 1
> SELECT count(*) FROM VALUES (NULL), (5), (5), (20) AS tab(col);
4
```

```sql
-- count, example 2
> SELECT count(col) FROM VALUES (NULL), (5), (5), (20) AS tab(col);
3
```

```sql
-- count, example 3
> SELECT count(DISTINCT col) FROM VALUES (NULL), (5), (5), (10) AS tab(col);
2
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 1.0.0.
